<reason>CON won by making actionability and definability the decision rule and holding it. Generic "AI ranks you" gives no why or fix to distinguish quiet week from burial, the bright line between settings and ranking collapses because distance/compatibility/safety are fused, and conduct remedies reach deception without branding users.
